svg.title: Check-mode timing swaps only tidy's provider
svg.desc: Benchmark runs temporarily replace only tidy's provider, leaving other feature modules active. ClangdMain supplies the module for check mode; timing does not insert modules into a caller-owned set. The first swap saves the original provider in the local variable; scope exit swaps it back.
svg.text: Check-mode timing swaps only tidy's provider
Benchmark runs temporarily replace only tidy's provider, leaving other feature modules active.
// Keep all other modules active while varying only tidy's configuration.
// ClangdMain installs the module even when tidy is disabled.
elog("Cannot time clang-tidy checks without a clang-tidy feature module");
// Provider now holds the original configuration; restore it on exit.
ClangdMain supplies the module for check mode; timing does not insert modules into a caller-owned set.
The first swap saves the original provider in the local variable; scope exit swaps it back.
Colors follow git diff · unchanged context is gray · arrows map responsibilities, not entire excerpts
